canDoYue: 你識打電話訂位，改時間，同確認個名。
canDoEn: Book a table by phone, change the time, and confirm the name.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Good evening. I would like to book a table, and is a window seat still available tonight?
dialogue.glossYue: 晚安。我想訂一張檯，今晚仲有冇靠窗位？
dialogue.say: Good evening. I would like to book a table, and is a window seat still available tonight?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: A window seat is free, and I can book a party of four under the name Mei.
dialogue.glossYue: 靠窗位仲有，我可以訂四位，個名寫 Mei。
dialogue.say: A window seat is free, and I can book a party of four under the name Mei.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Would it be possible to change the time, and please keep the table if we arrive later?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以改時間？如果我哋遲啲到，請留住張檯。
dialogue.say: Would it be possible to change the time, and please keep the table if we arrive later?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: I can still change the reservation for you, and the window table stays under the name Mei.
dialogue.glossYue: 我仍然可以幫你改訂位，靠窗檯仍然用 Mei 個名。
dialogue.say: I can still change the reservation for you, and the window table stays under the name Mei.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: We may need an outdoor table, and I will cancel the window seat if it rains.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋可能要室外檯，如果落雨我就取消靠窗位。
dialogue.say: We may need an outdoor table, and I will cancel the window seat if it rains.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: The outdoor tables are already fully booked, but I can still add your name to the waitlist.
dialogue.glossYue: 室外檯已經訂滿，不過我仍然可以將你個名加入候補。
dialogue.say: The outdoor tables are already fully booked, but I can still add your name to the waitlist.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please confirm the reservation for us now, and roughly what time should we come for dinner?
dialogue.glossYue: 請而家幫我哋確認訂位，晚餐大概幾點到？
dialogue.say: Please confirm the reservation for us now, and roughly what time should we come for dinner?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: I confirm a table for four, and I will hold it under the name Mei until eight.
dialogue.glossYue: 我確認四位一檯，會用 Mei 個名留到八點。
dialogue.say: I confirm a table for four, and I will hold it under the name Mei until eight.
